description: Screenshot of a live page in a real browser: desktop, laptop, tablet or phone, first screen, full page or one element, light or dark theme. Loads lazy content first, hides what you name, reports the HTTP status and load time. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Web tools: A real browser for agents: screenshot any page on desktop or phone, read a page as clean Markdown, print a URL or HTML to PDF, draw HTML to an image, make social cards, audit a page for SEO, speed, accessibility and broken links, and compare two versions of a page pixel by pixel..

dark.description: Ask the page for its dark theme (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

device.description: desktop 1280x800, laptop 1440x900, tablet 810x1080, phone 390x844 with a mobile browser identity.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrolling page, not just the first screen. Lazy content is loaded first.

hide.description: CSS selectors to hide first: cookie banners, chat bubbles, sticky bars.

scale.description: Pixel density. 2 gives retina sharpness at four times the pixels.

url.description: Public http(s) address of the page.

waitFor.description: CSS selector that must be visible before the capture.

waitMs.description: Extra wait after the page has loaded, for animations or late content.

width.description: Viewport width; overrides the device preset.

name: web_tools_screenshot
